sources.label: Official Superdry women's size guide (product-page Size Guide, served from Superdry's own CDN; cm ranges)
Product page the guide was opened from

audit: Stored URL /info/size-guide now 404s; the women's guide is the product-page Size Guide (loaded from cdn.superdry.com). Stored letter-to-UK mapping was off by one size: Superdry's chart is XXS = UK 6, XS = 8, S = 10, M = 12, L = 14, XL = 16, XXL = 18 (stored had XS = 6 … 2XL = 16). Measurements are now the published cm ranges, e.g. M (UK 12) was bust 90 / waist 71 / hips 95 → 93–98 / 74–79 / 98–103; XL (UK 16) was bust 98 / waist 79 / hips 103 → 103–108 / 84–89 / 108–113. XXS and XXL (UK 18) added. Hips = the chart's 'Low hip / Seat'. US/CA and EU from the guide's International Sizing table. The old notes ('M fits UK 10–12, size up one') contradicted the official chart and were replaced.
notes: British brand with Japanese-inspired graphics. The official women's chart pairs each letter size with one UK size: XXS = UK 6, XS = 8, S = 10, M = 12, L = 14, XL = 16, XXL = 18, with bust, waist and low-hip ranges in cm. Some styles come in dual sizes (6/8, 10/12, 14/16).
